decision.source_sample: 5/5 qualified-supported; no new material source contradiction found
decision.case_library_and_comparative_synthesis: materially improved; useful scoped evidence and analytical connections
decision.forthcoming_layer: excluded from this review; no verdict on unfinished or later changes

findings.title: An integrated historical relationship map remains absent from the frozen edition
findings.why_it_matters: The collection supports connected analytical comparison and local historical episodes, but cannot yet be followed across cases as an evidence-bearing account of predecessor developments, transmission, dependencies or convergences. Honest disclaimers correctly prevent overclaiming; they do not complete that requested layer.
findings.acceptance_condition: Supply the separately planned historical relationship layer with explicit configuration endpoints, dates/regions, typed relationship meaning, claim/source/passage traceability, alternatives and uncertainty. Demonstrate at least substantive historical routes linking relevant cases across the requested eras and regions; do not use chronological proximity or shared concepts as causal evidence. A single universal lineage or a fully connected graph is not required. Unsupported links should remain explicitly unknown. The new layer requires its own bounded source and render/integration checks.
findings.not_a_finding: Disconnectedness by itself is not error. No assertion that all cases must be connected, that every edge must cross strands, or that the underlying local evidence is false.

relationships.judgment: Copying H4 into K1 is an evidenced local development/transmission step. Enables is acceptable within this commissioned-copy configuration; serial manufacture, cheap access and universal necessity are not claimed.
relationships.chronology: 1766 commission and 1769 completion are supported; approximate 1771 delivery in the obituary is a distinct reported event and does not undermine the copying link.
relationships.historical_map_role: A real local historical path, but neither endpoint joins another case or strand.

relationships.category: observed and retrospectively described skill transmission
relationships.judgment: Documented transmission is warranted for supervised participation passing practical work and learning opportunities. The local garage source does not establish a general transfer law, typical outcome or exclusive training route, and the edge does not assert those.
relationships.chronology: 1960s–1980s histories are kept separate from 2011–2012 field observation.
relationships.historical_map_role: An internal training-to-repair relationship, not an evidenced lineage connecting automobile technology across cases.

relationships.category: bounded network transmission with unresolved causal components
relationships.judgment: The edge accurately represents contact-associated replication in the investigated early network. Failed contacts and possible written-only routes remain explicit; enables does not become necessity or sufficiency.
relationships.chronology: The summer 1971 British sample and North American contacts fit the source; the 1975 power-unit follow-up is not folded into this edge.
relationships.historical_map_role: A real within-case diffusion history, compressed to one contributor-to-copy edge; it does not connect the wider historical map.

relationships.category: historically overlapping cross-strand comparison, not an extra causal edge
relationships.judgment: The comparison validly joins actor/process history to spatial rail evidence and recognises their shared scholarship. Added road agency does not refute rail effects. Local complements and competition are separately period-scoped.
relationships.chronology: Earlier feeder complementarity and later 1920s–1930/31 competition are supported. Repaired GHA-K11/GHA-S05 references to §4.1 pp. 11–12 and §5.1.3 p. 18 are verified.
relationships.historical_map_role: Substantive connected regional interpretation, but the comparison adds no traversable evidence-bearing historical relationship between case nodes.

relationships.category: cross-period cross-strand comparison with shared-source dependence
relationships.judgment: The contrast between pre-1949 hybrid textiles and later constrained household production is supported as a comparison. Same-article dependence and unequal units are explicit; the record does not assert that one case causally produced the other.
relationships.chronology: Distinct regimes and locations are preserved; post-1950s procurement and labour arrangements are not projected backward.
relationships.historical_map_role: A useful historical comparison, not a demonstrated transmission or dependence link between the two configurations.

scope_limits: Targeted cited passages only. Unchanged claims,9 bounded-necessity edges, unselected transmission links, econometric estimates and full source corpus not re-audited.

requested_locator_repair.details: January 2015 manuscript §4.1 pp. 11–12 and §5.1.3 p. 18 are correct.
